notes.what_would_flip_it: An initial FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guide with a midpoint at or below $11.10 (the current low estimate) combined with a Q4 Security non-GAAP operating margin below ~19%. A FY27 guide of $10.90-$11.30 AFTER Mexico has rolled off would say the ex-Mexico business is decelerating, invalidate the bull thesis, force cuts to FY27/FY28, and plausibly produce a third consecutive double-digit gap-down toward the $197.27 June low. The tell on the call: whether management QUANTIFIES the FY26 Mexico revenue base that is annualising away. If they will not size it, assume it is flattering the growth optics.
notes.triage_rationale_response: The triage note ('universe at or below the triage threshold - all eligible names carried forward') gave no view. My conclusion is that OSIS deserved to be carried forward on its own merits, not by default: it is a genuine high-variance binary. Implied move 7.29% against a 6-print realised mean of 10.79% and an AMC-era mean of 12.83%, a de-risked Q4 bar sitting in the bottom 13-24% of the company's own guidance range, and a single unpublished number (initial FY27 guidance) that decides the outcome. The name has cleanly identifiable asymmetry; what it lacks is any way to see the deciding variable in advance, which is why my conviction is Low despite a positive lean.
